acceptance.given: The validator has produced a validation finding for a package containing an A15 secret-using capability defect.

oracle.expected: The structured finding contains exactly the finding location and rule fields, identifying the defect location and A15 rule.
forbidden: The finding includes additional information, including credential values.
oracle.observable: The validator finding object and serialized CLI/API result are inspected during the validation case.

acceptance.then: The finding is reported using only location and rule.
acceptance.when: During execution of the validator A15 finding-reporting path, inspect the emitted structured result before terminal aggregation.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Constrain A15 validation findings to expose only location and rule while preserving their required values.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema change; reverting restores prior finding serialization behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: A validation finding transitions from an unconstrained diagnostic payload to a bounded location-and-rule report.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The exact A15 pytest case passes and the applicable validator test module confirms no extra finding fields or credential values are emitted.
